newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish end-October EBR 134 mln punts - Finance Dept.
newsitem.headline: Irish end-October EBR 134 mln punts - Finance Dept.

text.p: Ireland's Exchequer Returns for end-October showed a deficit of 134 million Irish pounds, the Department of Finance said on Monday.
At end-September the Exchequer Returns showed a surplus of 185 million punts.
Total tax receipts for the 10 months to end-October came to 10,260 million punts versus 9,206 million a year earlier, the Department of Finance said.
Miscellaneous revenue came to 372 million punts and other receipts were 307 million punts.
On the spending side, central fund issues for the 10 months came to 2,612 million punts and supply services were 8,649 million.
Other issues totalled 31 million punts versus 23 million for the equivalent 10 months in 1995.
